evidence: Butcher's Ice Slab is a real named ice feature at the Small Pines / Butchers crags in Vermont (Mountain Project 'VT Ice and Mixed > Small Pines > Butcher's Ice Slab' tick for Small Pines WI2-3). 'Ice' is part of the place name.

29 routes spread along the Banks Lake roadside (Emerald pullout, Salt and Pepper, The Cable, Zenith...), but no source found tying them to named crags; only 'Emerald Pullout' is named and covers one route. Not renamed to avoid inventing a place. Needs owner decision. Sources: mountainproject.com/area/116630932, cascadeclimbers.com TRs.

Routes (Drury Falls, The Pencil, The Drip, Plastic Fantastic, Comic Book Hero) are at different spots in Tumwater Canyon (The Drip is 200 ft south of the dam; Drury Falls needs a river crossing). No single place name found; Drury Falls is a route name so cannot be the area name. Sources: cascadeclimbers.com Drury Falls TRs, mountainproject.com/route/200442156/the-drip.
Black Ice Crag is the real name of the Exit 38 dry-tooling crag; Pioneer Route and Turkey Scratch are listed there on Mountain Project (mountainproject.com/route/113869431/the-pioneer-route).

CYA is on Black Ice Crag per climberkyle.com/2023/02/02/cya-wi4-black-ice-crag/, and this leaf sits ~30 m from the Black Ice Crag leaf, so it is likely the upper tier of it; but no source confirms the 'Upper' split or places 'unknown', so left in place rather than merged. Owner may choose to merge into wa_black_ice_crag_drytooling_park.

moves.evidence: The Upper West Side is on Chair Peak (AAJ article 13201216010, Telstad)
Southeast Gully is a Guye Peak route; id prefix wa_guye_peak and known Guye Peak SE Gully scramble; no direct page fetched

evidence: Leaf is a Mountain Project-style 'Winter-Spring' bucket. New York Gully, The Snostril (AAJ: Snoqualmie Mountain Northwest Face) and Boogie Wonderland (MP: right side of the NW Face of Snoqualmie Mountain) all sit on Snoqualmie Mountain's NW face, so the leaf is renamed for that (Snoqualmie Mountain itself is a parent with subareas, cannot hold routes). Unresolved, left in leaf: East Face Variation (MP: 5 pitch Grade III, peak not stated) and Northeast Slabs (MP: on The Tooth, a parent area; no leaf to move to). Sources: mountainproject.com/route/122019734/boogie-wonderland, publications.americanalpineclub.org/articles/13201215904, mountainproject.com/route/116596486/northeast-slabs.
